name: flet-box-docs
description: The FletBox Book as an app: the framework's full documentation rendered by its own Markdown widget, with a catalog, cross-document navigation, a light/dark toggle, an offline cache, and Capacitor wrappers for Android and iOS.
author: Maenys Javier Quesada Reyes

scripts.build: node scripts/check-version.mjs && flet-box createBundle www && node scripts/copy-docs.mjs www && node scripts/spa-fallback.mjs www
scripts.android:init: npm run build && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npm run native:version && cap sync android && npm run android:icons
scripts.ios:init: npm run build && cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npm run native:version && cap sync ios && npm run ios:icons
